title: Blind adjudication refutation (one judgment)
description: refuted is true only when the retained evidence shows the judge's pick is wrong or rests on a path that does not show what the judge says. leak is true, with leak_text quoting what was found, when the input shows reviewer identity (adjudication-prompt.md, the leak check); the other fields are then placeholders and adjudicate.py records the judgment as missing (failure leak). Otherwise leak is false and leak_text is empty.
